name: DexaCube 3D for Elementor
author: dexaweb

sections.description:
DexaCube 3D for Elementor lets you replace static sliders with an interactive 3D cube experience.

Features:
– Interactive 3D cube
– Touch and mouse support
– Responsive design
– Elementor integration
– Neon edges (basic) with presets, direction, and intensity

Third Party Libraries

This plugin bundles the following third-party libraries:

  • Splide.js
    License: MIT
    Source: https://splidejs.com/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Elementor and add the DexaCube 3D for Elementor widget.
sections.faq:
Is there a Pro version?

Yes. An extended version with additional features is available.
